text: Capture custom events with attached properties from any SDK
quote: Custom events you capture from any SDK, each with the properties you attach to them.

text: Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor
quote: Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor.

text: Build insights, assemble dashboards, share them, and set alerts on key numbers
quote: Build insights, assemble dashboards, share them, and set alerts on the numbers that matter.

text: Session replay plays back real user sessions with a synced DevTools panel for console logs, network requests, and errors
quote: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR, with a synced DevTools panel showing console logs, network requests, and errors at the exact moment they happened.

text: Wrap a change in a feature flag, roll it out to a percentage of users, and turn it off instantly without redeploying
quote: Wrap a change in a flag, roll it out to 1% of users, watch what happens, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong – no redeploy, no hotfix.

text: Target feature flag rollouts by person property, cohort, or group, then view replays, events, and exceptions from affected users
quote: Roll out by person property, cohort, or group, then see the session replays, events, and exceptions from the people who got the flag

text: Run A/B experiments with defined variants and metrics, automatic randomization, exposure tracking, and Bayesian or frequentist statistics
quote: You define variants, pick the metrics you care about, and PostHog randomizes your users, tracks their exposures, and runs the statistics – Bayesian or frequentist

text: Query and manage data throughout the platform using SQL, including SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, etc.
quote: SQL insights enable you to directly query your data with SQL commands like SELECT, FROM, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY

text: Sync external sources like Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, and HubSpot and query them alongside events/persons/sessions in one SQL query
quote: Sync Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, and dozens of other sources, then query them alongside your events, persons, and sessions in one SQL query – no ETL pipeline to build and no second analytics tool to keep in sync.

text: Ingest data from connected tools, filter/reshape events as they arrive, and route the result onward in realtime or on a schedule
quote: It pulls data in from the tools you already use, lets you filter and reshape events as they're ingested, and sends the result wherever it needs to go – in realtime or on a schedule.

text: Capture events from any language capable of sending HTTP requests
quote: capture events from any language that can send HTTP requests

text: AI agent pulls the stack trace, error message, and metadata for a crash to propose a code fix
quote: "Show me the full stack trace for the most recent crash, then propose a fix." – Pulls the stack trace, error message, and metadata so the agent can suggest code changes.

text: Inject and upload source maps to support error tracking
quote: Inject and upload source maps for PostHog error tracking

text: Open-source product that can be self-hosted via a free Docker Compose deployment under MIT license
quote: PostHog is open-source and freely available for anyone to host themselves. We offer a free Docker Compose deployment under an MIT license.

text: Turn product signals like errors, rage clicks, and failed queries into researched reports and pull requests you review and merge
quote: Turn signals in your product data (errors, rage clicks, failed queries, and more) into researched reports and pull requests you review and merge.

text: Steer the product from Slack, web, desktop app, or your own editor via MCP
quote: You can steer it all from Slack, web, desktop (PostHog Desktop), or your own editor via the MCP.

text: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on captured events
quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog, then save them to dashboards, share them, and get alerted when they move.

text: Agents can ship feature flags, debug stack traces, run HogQL queries, triage tickets, and set up CDP destinations via plain-text prompts
quote: with just plain text questions your agents can ship a feature flag from a prompt, dig into a stack trace without leaving your editor, run a HogQL query through Claude, triage a support ticket, set up a CDP destination, and much more.

text: Official CLI usable from terminal, coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines
quote: The PostHog CLI lets you use PostHog from your terminal, your coding agents, local scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.

text: Track errors, get alerted, and resolve issues to improve product quality
quote: Track errors, get alerts, and resolve issues to improve your product.

text: Create surveys using no-code templates or a custom survey builder
quote: Ask anything with our collection of no-code survey templates, or build custom surveys with our survey builder.

text: Monitor web traffic, sessions, conversion, web vitals, and revenue in a GA-like dashboard
quote: Monitor web traffic and user sessions with a GA-like dashboard. Easily monitor conversion, web vitals, and revenue.

text: Capture traces, generations, latency, and cost data for LLM-powered applications (AI observability)
quote: Capture traces, generations, latency, and cost for your LLM-powered app.

text: Create workflows that automate actions or send messages to users
quote: Create workflows that automate actions or send messages to your users.

text: Combine all data sources into a context warehouse queryable by you, agents, or dashboards
quote: Combine everything in PostHog's context warehouse so that you, your agents, and your dashboard can query it directly.

text: Configure pipeline (Hog) functions from a template, write them yourself, or have the built-in AI write them for you
quote: Pipelines are built from Hog functions, which you can configure from a template, write yourself, or have PostHog AI write for you.

text: Automatically open a draft pull request for obvious code fixes, like removing dead flag checks, for you to review and merge
quote: Only the obvious code changes, like removing the dead check behind a ghost flag, auto-open a draft PR for you to review and merge.
